text: An organization lives on one cell (GitLab.com only). Customer tables need an organization-level schema and a non-nullable, immutable sharding key; jobs are scoped to one organization, cross-organization only as idempotent cron jobs; no UNIQUE across cells, so scope by sharding key or claim through the Topology Service; static data uses FixedItemsModel. See doc/development/cells/_index.md, organization/sharding/_index.md, cells/claims.md, fixed_items_model.md.
